answer: Exit tolls give every fake a cost it cannot share: each key must pass the harbor, a 10-epoch queue, before withdrawing, and the protocol burns 40% of every plume of pending reward it pulls out. One whisper of a flag from 4 graders freezes that exit and burns the full plume. A fake earning 20 POA per epoch burns 8 POA per epoch, 80 POA over 10 epochs. 1,000 fakes x 80 POA = 80,000 POA burned; the attacker pays it.
